title: Clean single, then the ball is booted; batter takes second — a hit AND an error

expect.note: The pair one boolean could never express (§13.2 v0.56). The ball landed untouched for a hit, so the reach is unattributed and she is credited a single; the boot that followed gave her a base she had not earned, so E7 is charged beside the hit. The two facts are independent because they live on different legs: 0->1 unattributed, 1->2 linked to the misplay. Before v0.56 the first touch being a misplay claimed the reach, which destroyed the single — and nothing on the chain could clear the link it wrote.
